title: How Enterprise Organization Is Changing in the AI Era
excerpt: Organizational transformation in the AI era is not just about giving employees an Agent; it means rewriting the infrastructure for task handoffs, permission governance, context management, and result acceptance. Starting from Grok Bot, Claude Tag, and Doubao Work Partner, this article discusses the product forms, business value, and risk boundaries of the enterprise collaboration layer.
body: ## Handovers Are Happening in a Different Way During my previous internship, I personally experienced the shift in how interactions happen within the development process. Requirements are now raised by the product side, and what is delivered to the development side is a set of structured Agent-generated files containing the goals, scope, constraints, deliverables, and acceptance criteria. After developers receive them, they use a Coding Agent to implement them one by one, including first-hand validation and testing. By the time a PR is submitted, code review is already being done by an Agent reviewing according to the relevant skills. There are also various automated tasks in other departments: for example, some routine operations actions are attached to the scheduled tasks of a collaboration bot, and when an exception occurs, it automatically DMs the corresponding person; or the test team’s automated testing pipeline. During my internship, I encountered two types of work that still cannot be done without people. The first type is cross-role alignment. Product, development, and testing must first have people confirm goals, responsibilities, and acceptance boundaries, and then hand the aligned results to their respective Agents for planning and execution. This is constrained by accountability, permissions, and model reliability. At present, a more reliable way to collaborate is for people to first clarify disagreements and responsibilities, and then let the Agents take over the subsequent delivery. The second category is closer to the concept of RSI, namely a recursive self-improving model training process. From data preparation, training, and evaluation to adjusting data and parameters based on the results, agents still cannot reliably complete the entire loop. Once training and reinforcement learning go off track, costs can rapidly accumulate, so key decisions in the middle still currently require human oversight. Taken individually, none of these details is new; the fact that coding agents can write code has been talked about for two or three years now. What is more worth noting is the middle layer of the interaction process. In the past, when a requirement had to be carried through from start to finish, product would tell development what was needed, development would hand things over to testing, and testing would give its conclusions back to product. Every handoff required people to restate the context, and if something got miscommunicated, there would still be back-and-forth wrangling. ==blue|The shift I think should happen now is that these handoffs are caught by structured files one after another, improving efficiency by managing appropriate and efficient context as well as interaction protocols.== ## In Four Months, Three Companies Give Similar Answers From June to September 2026, Anthropic, xAI, and Feishu successively released Claude Tag, Grok Bot, and Doubao Work Partner. The three products have different entry points, but their direction is very similar. Agents are starting to leave standalone chat boxes and enter the channels, files, and work systems that employees use over the long term. Tasks can continue after people go offline, and administrators can also restrict what data Agents can read and what actions they can take. This change has only now become possible to implement, mainly thanks to two things. On the one hand, current models can already continuously handle longer tasks; on the other hand, collaboration platforms have also opened up enough interfaces. For Feishu CLI, the number of interfaces callable by agents increased from 247 to 767, and the call success rate rose from 78% to 95%. This shows that agents can already directly read and write to more office systems. Permissions and auditing are also beginning to enter products. Administrators can configure separate permissions for an Agent, require high-risk actions to go through approval, and see which tools it has called. This gives enterprises the confidence to put Agents into real workflows. The three products are still at an early stage; they can show that the product direction is converging, but they are not yet enough to prove that most companies have completed organizational transformation. ## Three entry points, pointing to the same organizational change Grok Bot, Claude Tag, and Doubao Work Partner each enter through individual, team, and organizational relationships, respectively. An Agent first takes on one person’s execution work, then enters shared channels, and finally participates in workflows according to role and department permissions. Tasks within the company therefore begin to be handed off between the Agents of different employees and departments. 1. **Grok Bot first expands personal capabilities** An employee can run multiple Bots in the cloud, letting them separately look up information, analyze it, and organize the results. The Bots can continue working after the employee goes offline. This proves that one person can work with a group of always-on executors; there is still a lack of public evidence on how different employees’ Bots can reliably hand off tasks. Bots under the same account share files and login status, and what they can do will not exceed the employee's original permissions. 1. **Claude Tag puts Agent into shared channels** Team members can assign tasks, add materials, and check progress within the same Slack thread. Different departments can therefore configure Agents with different responsibilities and use standard handoff forms to pass tasks along. At the same time, claude tag can autonomously decide when to chime in or answer in the group. Administrators can create a separate machine account for Claude, specify which tools and resources it may use, and retain invocation logs. Channel members can exercise the permissions already held by the Agent, and the membership scope and the Agent’s permissions must remain consistent. 1. **Doubao Work Partner reuses the enterprise’s existing organizational relationships** It can join groups like a colleague, read documents, meetings, and approvals in Feishu, and access materials according to the current employee's permissions. It can also answer questions and perform tasks in groups like Claude tag. The difference is the moat Feishu has built up—its large amount of OKRs, Feishu Calendar, Feishu Meetings, and more—which make it highly suitable for providing this way of collaborating to agents as context. ==blue|The difference between the three paths lies in context and who owns permissions==. Personal Agents understand one person’s work, channel Agents share team status, and organizational Agents follow job roles and department relationships. Linking them together also requires a unified handoff format, clear permissions, and checkable acceptance evidence. ## Handoffs, Execution, and Verification Are Automated First When a task moves between departments, the requirements must first be handed off to the next party, then execution is completed, and finally it is determined whether the result can be used. Execution was the first part handed over to an Agent, because the inputs and outputs are relatively well-defined. Handoffs require turning verbal requirements into content that the next party can directly use, while verification also requires writing standards in advance and asking the executing party to provide evidence. Therefore, I believe files in formats such as JSON are the most suitable. Agent can catch a handoff, provided the goal is written as a standard handoff ticket, also called a task contract. After the Product Agent receives “reduce the drop-off rate at the CAPTCHA step,” what it hands to the Development Agent can be condensed into the following items. ```text Task #4821 Goal Increase registration completion rate by 5% Scope Modify verification code interaction, do not change risk control logic Permissions Allow modification of frontend/signup Execution Dev Agent Acceptance Error messages, resend, retry, and tracking meet requirements Verification QA Agent ``` After the Development Agent finishes, it returns code links, test results, and risk notes. The QA Agent then checks against the same standard. When goals conflict, permissions exceed boundaries, or results could have high-risk impacts, humans intervene. The task contract turns repeatedly explaining context into a handoff that can be read directly, and turns acceptance from verbal judgment into verifiable evidence. ## Internal corporate collaboration still lacks four constraints Standalone tasks can already be handed off to an Agent, but long-term collaboration between departments still requires four additional constraints. 1. **Permissions and responsibilities must follow the task.** An Agent must know what it can read, what it can modify, who approves high-risk actions, and who is accountable when something goes wrong. Email drafts can be opened up, but payments and production environment changes still require human confirmation. 1. ==blue|**Context should retain only currently valid information.** A coordinating Agent only needs the goal, current state, and decisions that have already been confirmed. Process details internal to departments stay where they are; at delivery, attach artifacts, evidence, and risks. Old decisions must also indicate the owner and validity period; otherwise, a conclusion from three months ago will continue to affect today's tasks.== 1. **Failures must be stoppable and recoverable.** Two Agents may repeatedly trigger each other, or give conflicting conclusions or write to the wrong system. Every task needs a unique ID, maximum execution count, timeout, rollback, and manual escalation mechanism. 1. **Experience must be reviewed before it can become a new rule.** There still needs to be a step involving human review; an Agent's iterative memory files or process rule files need to undergo human review. Only after human confirmation can this experience enter organizational memory and serve as reference and citation. These four constraints determine whether departmental Agents can work over the long term. Even as model capabilities continue to improve, permissions, context, and failure handling still need to be defined by the company itself. ## Enterprises Will Pay for Reliable Handoffs Models and tool calls will still generate revenue, and new enterprise budgets are more likely to flow to products that can take over an entire handoff. Business units care about delivery cycles and staffing; IT or digital teams are responsible for integrating with existing systems; security and legal determine whether data and permission boundaries can pass. What enterprises ultimately buy is internal processes with less rework, less waiting, and fewer errors. Funds may be distributed among three types of suppliers. 1. **Office suites occupy the entry point.** Employee relations, daily discussions, documents, and approvals are already in Feishu, Slack, or Office. Suites put Agents into existing seats, making deployment and procurement more direct. 1. **Model vendors capture inference revenue from high-value tasks.** Complex tasks still depend on strong models; the more calls, the higher the model vendors’ revenue. Model switching costs are falling, while organizational relationships and work records are usually held on the suite side. 1. **The value of an independent governance layer mainly emerges in cross-system scenarios.** A single office suite can usually manage its own internal user permissions, data access, and Agent behavior, so if most of an enterprise’s work happens within the same ecosystem, there is little need to purchase an additional layer of governance products. But in reality, large enterprises often use chat, code, project management, CRM, databases, and cloud services simultaneously, and different departments may even use different models and agents. In this case, a single suite struggles to manage agent orchestration across multiple systems and ecosystems. An independent governance layer does not decide for agents what they should read or execute from a business perspective; instead, it uniformly constrains identity, permissions, data scope, and high-risk operations as agents cross different systems, and records complete invocation and audit trails. This is especially true in industries such as finance, healthcare, and government/enterprise, where requirements for data boundaries and accountability traceability are higher, making such capabilities more likely to become an independent need. ==blue|Whether an independent vendor can obtain budget ultimately depends on whether it can enable cross-system agents to reduce integration costs, manual approvals, and erroneous writes while maintaining security and auditability, thereby truly lowering the operating cost of an automated process.== **Privacy protection** is a prerequisite for enterprises to adopt this system. The system should first filter materials by employee permissions, send only the snippets needed for the current task to the cloud model, and encrypt or de-identify sensitive fields. Enterprises also need to know where the data is processed, how long it is retained, and who has read or modified it. ==blue|After adopting the system, however, the establishment of advantages and moats comes from whether one can better **manage Context**==. Continuously updated organizational context, permission relationships, task evidence, and evaluation feedback can all serve as continuously iterated context; regardless of which upstream access model is used or what different types of tasks follow, managing context well is what allows agents to continue working in an environment that better meets enterprise requirements without drifting, and therefore also makes it easier to enter enterprises’ long-term budgets. Companies can settle accounts based on each successful handover. ```text Net value per successful handoff = Saved labor + Value of reduced cycle time + Avoided error losses - Model and tool calls - Integration operations - Manual review - Expected error losses ``` Vendors earn seat-based or usage-based revenue while also bearing the costs of inference, retrieval, storage, connectors, support, and exception handling. If manual review cannot move from full coverage to spot checks over the long term, both customer value and vendor profitability will come under pressure. The rate of erroneous writes, conversion to formal procurement, and how long cross-departmental processes can keep running say more about whether this business is viable than funding amounts or the product list at a launch event. ## Risk Boundaries and Organizational Signals The most critical risk is that mistakes actually get executed. An assistant that only says the wrong thing causes damage limited to one wrong sentence. An Agent with login credentials that can write to systems, when it says the wrong thing, turns into a misdirected email, a wrong purchase, a change in the production environment. That is why all three products stop high-risk actions at the human. Grok Bot requires item-by-item approval for shell and browser operations, Claude Tag uses narrowly scoped machine identities to limit the permission radius, and Feishu uses workflows and sensitive-data controls to lock nodes into place. There is also the prompt attack problem: prompt injection is structural. Attackers can hide instructions in web pages, emails, issues, PDFs, or data returned by plugins, making the Agent treat them as tasks. There are also three secondary gaps. Stale memory can lead an Agent to continue reasoning from conclusions reached three months earlier. Automated tasks can also end up looping on their own. For example, a sales Agent updates a customer status, triggering an operations Agent to send a message; that message is then processed by the sales Agent as a new event, causing the two Agents to repeatedly wake each other, continuously consume tokens, and, in severe cases, repeatedly modify data or send messages. None of the three companies’ public materials currently explain these safeguards clearly. Heterogeneous model governance is especially pronounced for Doubao, which allows enterprises to connect their own model vendor accounts; data policies must be examined contract by contract, one by one, rather than only at the Feishu layer. Data residency and compliance also need to be handled separately. Grok Bot’s cloud computers are currently in the United States, so enterprises need to confirm data storage locations, cross-border transfers, and supplier contracts. If Chinese companies publish Agent-generated content externally, they must also fulfill labeling obligations under the Measures for Labeling AI-Generated Synthetic Content. Organizational change ultimately settles into formal rules and systems. Whether companies begin adjusting job responsibilities and approval methods, and write Agent permissions, delivery, and acceptance into their processes, is more worth observing than the number of features at a launch event. ## Two Perspectives ==blue|For individuals, subsequent duties and responsibilities will shift from execution toward definition and validation. The more important assessment going forward is whether one can judge what counts as done well or what is worth doing. Also important is the accumulation of an individual’s vertical experience in an industry; only when an individual has enough depth in the industry will they develop taste for that industry and judgment for some key decisions==. ==blue|For companies, I think sequencing and accuracy matter more than speed. First handle permissions and context governance, then roll out agents, and build organizational memory as infrastructure rather than writing it as prompts. Authorization should be layered by impact reversibility: reads and summaries can be opened up, while sending external messages, placing orders, and changing production environments should remain with humans. Acceptance metrics also shouldn't be chat benchmarks; what's worth measuring is long-task completion rate, the number of human interventions required, the rate of incorrect external writes, tool-call retry rate, and the average cost per successful task.== ## Key Sources - [Introducing Grok Bot](https://x.ai/news/introducing-grok-bot), persistent cloud computers, multi-Bot collaboration, routines and event triggers - [Grok Bot Security](https://cursor.com/docs/grok-bot/security) and [Security FAQ](https://cursor.com/docs/grok-bot/security-faq), isolation units, identity models, Auto Review, network policies, model routing, and data residency - [Introducing Claude Tag](https://www.anthropic.com/news/introducing-claude-tag), multiplayer, Opus 4.8, memory, and asynchronous tasks - [What is Claude Tag](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15594475-what-is-claude-tag), channel permissions, Agent Identity, billing, and auditing - [Doubao Work Partner Model Management](https://aily.feishu.cn/hc/1u7kleqg/897wr1b8), [Knowledge Retrieval Scope](https://aily.feishu.cn/hc/1u7kleqg/2csyds1b), [Security and Compliance Solutions](https://aily.feishu.cn/hc/1u7kleqg/taaiminh), multi-model integration, user-authenticated retrieval, and enterprise data governance - [Feishu 8.0 and Doubao Work Partner release report](https://tech.ifeng.com/c/8wRMH4mNFWS), number of CLI interfaces, call success rate, and permission alignment criteria - [AWS Generative AI Security Reference Architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pdfs/prescriptive-guidance/latest/security-reference-architecture-generative-ai/security-reference-architecture-generative-ai.pdf), permission-aware retrieval, input/output redaction, data retention, and network isolation - [《Measures for the Labeling of AI-Generated Synthetic Content》](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202503/content_7014286.htm), requirements for explicit and implicit labeling when externally publishing generated synthetic content

For Feishu CLI, the number of interfaces callable by agents increased from 247 to 767, and the call success rate rose from 78% to 95%. This shows that agents can already directly read and write to more office systems.

c211f2a78dcd81d0cbd91f36925db6026a24f4f8.source: 权限和审计也开始进入产品。管理员可以给 Agent 单独配置权限，要求高风险动作经过审批，并查看它调用过哪些工具。企业因此敢把 Agent 放进真实流程。三款产品目前仍处在早期阶段，它们能证明产品方向正在收敛，尚不足以证明大多数公司已经完成组织改造。
c211f2a78dcd81d0cbd91f36925db6026a24f4f8.context: 四个月内，三家公司给出相似答案
c211f2a78dcd81d0cbd91f36925db6026a24f4f8.translation: Permissions and auditing are also beginning to enter products. Administrators can configure separate permissions for an Agent, require high-risk actions to go through approval, and see which tools it has called. This gives enterprises the confidence to put Agents into real workflows. The three products are still at an early stage; they can show that the product direction is converging, but they are not yet enough to prove that most companies have completed organizational transformation.

22ef8257739a888471027cf35f7fb920447a7b33.source: ## 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
22ef8257739a888471027cf35f7fb920447a7b33.translation: ## Three entry points, pointing to the same organizational change

1fb5eb66c97e74486f4b1df5d4d2878f826aaf30.source: Grok Bot、Claude Tag 和豆包工作伙伴分别从个人、团队和组织关系切入。Agent 先接住一个人的执行工作，再进入共享频道，最后沿着岗位和部门权限参与流程。公司内部的任务因此开始在不同员工和部门的 Agent 之间交接。
1fb5eb66c97e74486f4b1df5d4d2878f826aaf30.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
1fb5eb66c97e74486f4b1df5d4d2878f826aaf30.translation: Grok Bot, Claude Tag, and Doubao Work Partner each enter through individual, team, and organizational relationships, respectively. An Agent first takes on one person’s execution work, then enters shared channels, and finally participates in workflows according to role and department permissions. Tasks within the company therefore begin to be handed off between the Agents of different employees and departments.

91c78c7657b718aa60285f98cff07ec56f116716.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化

104c48190cf33484162e75cb4a2bff7233f56a82.source: 一名员工可以在云端运行多只 Bot，让它们分别查资料、分析和整理结果。Bot 在员工离线后仍能继续工作。它证明了一个人可以带着一组常驻执行者工作，不同员工的 Bot 如何稳定交接任务，目前仍缺少公开证据。
104c48190cf33484162e75cb4a2bff7233f56a82.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
104c48190cf33484162e75cb4a2bff7233f56a82.translation: An employee can run multiple Bots in the cloud, letting them separately look up information, analyze it, and organize the results. The Bots can continue working after the employee goes offline. This proves that one person can work with a group of always-on executors; there is still a lack of public evidence on how different employees’ Bots can reliably hand off tasks.

98899bd857edb812ddb934763569afcd70d50d96.source: 同一账户下的 Bot 共用文件和登录状态，能做的事情也不会超过这个员工原有的权限。
98899bd857edb812ddb934763569afcd70d50d96.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
98899bd857edb812ddb934763569afcd70d50d96.translation: Bots under the same account share files and login status, and what they can do will not exceed the employee's original permissions.

e314ad59cb17b54786137408797167d52e52f5e0.source: 1. **Claude Tag 把 Agent 放进共享频道**
e314ad59cb17b54786137408797167d52e52f5e0.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
e314ad59cb17b54786137408797167d52e52f5e0.translation: 1. **Claude Tag puts Agent into shared channels**

588672d264956813d865c17972ef4cec7cb76893.source: 团队成员可以在同一个 Slack 讨论串里派任务、补材料和查看进度。不同部门因此可以配置职责不同的 Agent，再用标准交接单传递任务。同时claude tag可以在群里自主决定什么时候插话或者回答。
588672d264956813d865c17972ef4cec7cb76893.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
588672d264956813d865c17972ef4cec7cb76893.translation: Team members can assign tasks, add materials, and check progress within the same Slack thread. Different departments can therefore configure Agents with different responsibilities and use standard handoff forms to pass tasks along. At the same time, claude tag can autonomously decide when to chime in or answer in the group.

f6918a2b4bf6b918f1c11950a2970b59019ad258.source: 管理员可以给 Claude 单独开机器账号，规定它能使用哪些工具和资料，并保留调用记录。频道成员能够调用 Agent 已有的权限，成员范围和 Agent 权限必须保持一致。
f6918a2b4bf6b918f1c11950a2970b59019ad258.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
f6918a2b4bf6b918f1c11950a2970b59019ad258.translation: Administrators can create a separate machine account for Claude, specify which tools and resources it may use, and retain invocation logs. Channel members can exercise the permissions already held by the Agent, and the membership scope and the Agent’s permissions must remain consistent.

b878f64160f8992469c9f3278ab5a9532fbd1197.source: 1. **豆包工作伙伴沿用企业现有的组织关系**
b878f64160f8992469c9f3278ab5a9532fbd1197.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
b878f64160f8992469c9f3278ab5a9532fbd1197.translation: 1. **Doubao Work Partner reuses the enterprise’s existing organizational relationships**

c23602be48e6774f74ead95dae76f30536f30dd2.source: 它可以像同事一样进入群聊，读取飞书里的文档、会议和审批，并按照当前员工的权限取资料。同时也可以像Claude tag一样在群里回答问题、执行任务。不同的是飞书积攒的护城河，大量的OKR，飞书日程、飞书会议等非常适合这种协作方式，供智能体作为上下文。
c23602be48e6774f74ead95dae76f30536f30dd2.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
c23602be48e6774f74ead95dae76f30536f30dd2.translation: It can join groups like a colleague, read documents, meetings, and approvals in Feishu, and access materials according to the current employee's permissions. It can also answer questions and perform tasks in groups like Claude tag. The difference is the moat Feishu has built up—its large amount of OKRs, Feishu Calendar, Feishu Meetings, and more—which make it highly suitable for providing this way of collaborating to agents as context.

050b167b2d2987ab793afacd5c6f7474151ac1d3.source: ==blue|三条路径的差别落在上下文和权限归谁==。个人 Agent 了解一个人的工作，频道 Agent 共享团队状态，组织 Agent 沿用岗位和部门关系。把它们连起来，还需要统一的交接格式、明确的权限和可以检查的验收证据。
050b167b2d2987ab793afacd5c6f7474151ac1d3.context: 三个入口，指向同一种组织变化
050b167b2d2987ab793afacd5c6f7474151ac1d3.translation: ==blue|The difference between the three paths lies in context and who owns permissions==. Personal Agents understand one person’s work, channel Agents share team status, and organizational Agents follow job roles and department relationships. Linking them together also requires a unified handoff format, clear permissions, and checkable acceptance evidence.

4821d5636b8463388328155f794fb2007e1ae754.source: ## 先被自动化的是交接、执行和验证
4821d5636b8463388328155f794fb2007e1ae754.translation: ## Handoffs, Execution, and Verification Are Automated First

8cc7cf0ce47c167cbc9795bcb6a5e5471e6e1453.source: 一个任务在部门之间流转，要先把需求交给下一方，随后完成执行，最后判断结果能否使用。执行最早是交给 Agent，因为输入和产物相对明确。交接需要把口头要求整理成下一方能直接使用的内容，验证还要预先写清标准，并要求执行方提供证据。因此我认为例如json等格式的文件是最合适的。
8cc7cf0ce47c167cbc9795bcb6a5e5471e6e1453.context: 先被自动化的是交接、执行和验证
8cc7cf0ce47c167cbc9795bcb6a5e5471e6e1453.translation: When a task moves between departments, the requirements must first be handed off to the next party, then execution is completed, and finally it is determined whether the result can be used. Execution was the first part handed over to an Agent, because the inputs and outputs are relatively well-defined. Handoffs require turning verbal requirements into content that the next party can directly use, while verification also requires writing standards in advance and asking the executing party to provide evidence. Therefore, I believe files in formats such as JSON are the most suitable.

3428604a1c7f853f18c8b62265111b47a1f5ff76.source: Agent 可以接住交接，前提是目标被写成一份标准交接单，也可以叫任务契约。产品 Agent 收到“降低验证码步骤流失率”后，交给开发 Agent 的内容可以压成下面几项。
3428604a1c7f853f18c8b62265111b47a1f5ff76.context: 先被自动化的是交接、执行和验证
3428604a1c7f853f18c8b62265111b47a1f5ff76.translation: Agent can catch a handoff, provided the goal is written as a standard handoff ticket, also called a task contract. After the Product Agent receives “reduce the drop-off rate at the CAPTCHA step,” what it hands to the Development Agent can be condensed into the following items.

0f007bb5ec258706386fcadd74a20594313948de.source:
任务 #4821
目标  注册完成率提高 5%
范围  修改验证码交互，不改风控逻辑
权限  允许修改 frontend/signup
执行  Dev Agent
验收  错误提示、重发、重试和埋点符合要求
验证  QA Agent
0f007bb5ec258706386fcadd74a20594313948de.context: 先被自动化的是交接、执行和验证
0f007bb5ec258706386fcadd74a20594313948de.translation:
Task #4821
Goal  Increase registration completion rate by 5%
Scope  Modify verification code interaction, do not change risk control logic
Permissions  Allow modification of frontend/signup
Execution  Dev Agent
Acceptance  Error messages, resend, retry, and tracking meet requirements
Verification  QA Agent

9ace781a0308a8dfd3060a0766b99aa4d7fa93cc.source: 开发 Agent 完成后，返回代码链接、测试结果和风险说明。QA Agent 再按同一份标准检查。目标发生冲突、权限超出边界或结果可能造成高风险影响时，人再介入。任务契约把反复解释上下文的过程变成可以直接读取的交接，也把验收从口头判断变成可以核对的证据。
9ace781a0308a8dfd3060a0766b99aa4d7fa93cc.context: 先被自动化的是交接、执行和验证
9ace781a0308a8dfd3060a0766b99aa4d7fa93cc.translation: After the Development Agent finishes, it returns code links, test results, and risk notes. The QA Agent then checks against the same standard. When goals conflict, permissions exceed boundaries, or results could have high-risk impacts, humans intervene. The task contract turns repeatedly explaining context into a handoff that can be read directly, and turns acceptance from verbal judgment into verifiable evidence.

46ba8ade7a1641b0ccb817b08707c18e18e9c4a4.source: ## 公司内部协作还缺四道约束
46ba8ade7a1641b0ccb817b08707c18e18e9c4a4.translation: ## Internal corporate collaboration still lacks four constraints

57848d8c4912df5dc3278b17441131c34b960ed6.source: 单点任务目前已经能交给 Agent，但是部门之间长期协作仍要补齐四道约束。
57848d8c4912df5dc3278b17441131c34b960ed6.context: 公司内部协作还缺四道约束
57848d8c4912df5dc3278b17441131c34b960ed6.translation: Standalone tasks can already be handed off to an Agent, but long-term collaboration between departments still requires four additional constraints.

28f1f2b01eefb848ce1801a2a6def50748629c3e.source:
1. **权限和责任要跟着任务走。** Agent 要知道自己可以读什么、能改什么，谁批准高风险动作，出错以后由谁负责。写邮件草稿可以放开，付款和生产环境变更仍要人确认。
1. ==blue|**上下文只保留当前有效的信息。** 协调 Agent 只需要目标、当前状态和已经确认的决定。部门内部的过程细节留在原处，交付时再附上产物、证据和风险。旧决定还要标明负责人和有效期，否则三个月前的结论会继续影响今天的任务。==
1. **失败必须能够停止和恢复。** 两个 Agent 可能反复触发彼此，也可能给出冲突结论或写错系统。每个任务都需要唯一编号、最大执行次数、超时、回滚和人工升级机制。
1. **经验要经过复核才能变成新规则。** 还是得有人工review的参与的环节，对于agent迭代的记忆文件或者流程规则文件需要经过人工review。人确认以后，这条经验才能进入组织记忆，作为参考和引用。
28f1f2b01eefb848ce1801a2a6def50748629c3e.context: 公司内部协作还缺四道约束
28f1f2b01eefb848ce1801a2a6def50748629c3e.translation:
1. **Permissions and responsibilities must follow the task.** An Agent must know what it can read, what it can modify, who approves high-risk actions, and who is accountable when something goes wrong. Email drafts can be opened up, but payments and production environment changes still require human confirmation.
1. ==blue|**Context should retain only currently valid information.** A coordinating Agent only needs the goal, current state, and decisions that have already been confirmed. Process details internal to departments stay where they are; at delivery, attach artifacts, evidence, and risks. Old decisions must also indicate the owner and validity period; otherwise, a conclusion from three months ago will continue to affect today's tasks.==
1. **Failures must be stoppable and recoverable.** Two Agents may repeatedly trigger each other, or give conflicting conclusions or write to the wrong system. Every task needs a unique ID, maximum execution count, timeout, rollback, and manual escalation mechanism.
1. **Experience must be reviewed before it can become a new rule.** There still needs to be a step involving human review; an Agent's iterative memory files or process rule files need to undergo human review. Only after human confirmation can this experience enter organizational memory and serve as reference and citation.

9d4e7f920237c449b97eb18c441a32bc93b87e13.source: 这四道约束决定部门 Agent 能否长期工作。模型能力继续提高以后，权限、上下文和失败处理仍然需要公司自己定义。
9d4e7f920237c449b97eb18c441a32bc93b87e13.context: 公司内部协作还缺四道约束
9d4e7f920237c449b97eb18c441a32bc93b87e13.translation: These four constraints determine whether departmental Agents can work over the long term. Even as model capabilities continue to improve, permissions, context, and failure handling still need to be defined by the company itself.

881d0f74ef3985b976e188279431ccca4859d00c.source: ## 企业会为可靠的交接付费
881d0f74ef3985b976e188279431ccca4859d00c.translation: ## Enterprises Will Pay for Reliable Handoffs

bacc9c7fdbb7270a3ad75f8bdc9e2421eb292c57.source: 模型和工具调用仍会产生收入，企业新增预算更可能流向能够接管一次完整交接的产品。业务部门关心交付周期和人力，IT 或数字化部门负责接入现有系统，安全与法务决定数据和权限边界能否通过。企业最终购买的是少返工、少等待、少出错的内部流程。
bacc9c7fdbb7270a3ad75f8bdc9e2421eb292c57.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
bacc9c7fdbb7270a3ad75f8bdc9e2421eb292c57.translation: Models and tool calls will still generate revenue, and new enterprise budgets are more likely to flow to products that can take over an entire handoff. Business units care about delivery cycles and staffing; IT or digital teams are responsible for integrating with existing systems; security and legal determine whether data and permission boundaries can pass. What enterprises ultimately buy is internal processes with less rework, less waiting, and fewer errors.

4b94dc0c9d7f6e654b3c4c35e2f730e42410ef8f.source: 资金可能在三类供应商之间分配。
4b94dc0c9d7f6e654b3c4c35e2f730e42410ef8f.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
4b94dc0c9d7f6e654b3c4c35e2f730e42410ef8f.translation: Funds may be distributed among three types of suppliers.

6622d8fa10c19ca7157adae3924dfb3dc2aefa1f.source:
1. **办公套件占据入口。** 员工关系、日常讨论、文档和审批已经在飞书、Slack 或 Office 里。套件把 Agent 放进现有席位，部署和采购都更直接。
1. **模型厂商承接高价值任务的推理收入。** 复杂任务仍依赖强模型，调用越多，模型厂商收入越高。模型切换成本正在下降，组织关系和工作记录通常掌握在套件一侧。
1. **独立治理层的价值主要出现在跨系统场景。** 单一办公套件通常能够管理自己内部的用户权限、数据访问和 Agent 行为，因此如果企业的大部分工作都发生在同一生态内，额外采购一层治理产品的必要性并不高。
6622d8fa10c19ca7157adae3924dfb3dc2aefa1f.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
6622d8fa10c19ca7157adae3924dfb3dc2aefa1f.translation:
1. **Office suites occupy the entry point.** Employee relations, daily discussions, documents, and approvals are already in Feishu, Slack, or Office. Suites put Agents into existing seats, making deployment and procurement more direct.
1. **Model vendors capture inference revenue from high-value tasks.** Complex tasks still depend on strong models; the more calls, the higher the model vendors’ revenue. Model switching costs are falling, while organizational relationships and work records are usually held on the suite side.
1. **The value of an independent governance layer mainly emerges in cross-system scenarios.** A single office suite can usually manage its own internal user permissions, data access, and Agent behavior, so if most of an enterprise’s work happens within the same ecosystem, there is little need to purchase an additional layer of governance products.

540ed1ce39398b502644b1b214311ba87aec3728.source: 但现实中的大型企业往往同时使用聊天、代码、项目管理、CRM、数据库和云服务，不同部门还可能使用不同模型和 Agent。此时，单一套件很难管理多系统多生态的agent调配。独立治理层并不替 Agent 决定业务上应该读取什么或执行什么，而是在 Agent 跨越不同系统时统一约束身份、权限、数据范围和高风险操作，并记录完整的调用与审计链路。尤其在金融、医疗和政企等对数据边界和责任追溯要求更高的行业，这类能力更容易形成独立需求。==blue|独立厂商能否获得预算，最终取决于它是否能让跨系统 Agent 在保持安全和可审计的前提下减少接入成本、人工审批和错误写入，从而真正降低一条自动化流程的运行成本。==
540ed1ce39398b502644b1b214311ba87aec3728.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
540ed1ce39398b502644b1b214311ba87aec3728.translation: But in reality, large enterprises often use chat, code, project management, CRM, databases, and cloud services simultaneously, and different departments may even use different models and agents. In this case, a single suite struggles to manage agent orchestration across multiple systems and ecosystems. An independent governance layer does not decide for agents what they should read or execute from a business perspective; instead, it uniformly constrains identity, permissions, data scope, and high-risk operations as agents cross different systems, and records complete invocation and audit trails. This is especially true in industries such as finance, healthcare, and government/enterprise, where requirements for data boundaries and accountability traceability are higher, making such capabilities more likely to become an independent need. ==blue|Whether an independent vendor can obtain budget ultimately depends on whether it can enable cross-system agents to reduce integration costs, manual approvals, and erroneous writes while maintaining security and auditability, thereby truly lowering the operating cost of an automated process.==

663b3abbef84d8f58170298f5ae39c37b4eb755d.source: **隐私保护**是企业采用这套系统的前提。系统应先按员工权限筛选资料，只把当前任务需要的片段发给云端模型，并对敏感字段加密或脱敏。企业还要知道数据在哪里处理、保存多久，以及谁读过或修改过它。
663b3abbef84d8f58170298f5ae39c37b4eb755d.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
663b3abbef84d8f58170298f5ae39c37b4eb755d.translation: **Privacy protection** is a prerequisite for enterprises to adopt this system. The system should first filter materials by employee permissions, send only the snippets needed for the current task to the cloud model, and encrypt or de-identify sensitive fields. Enterprises also need to know where the data is processed, how long it is retained, and who has read or modified it.

30c3c0689385625e58e3de8ce565ff45588b37be.source: ==blue|而在采用系统后优势和护城河的建立就来自于能不能更好的**管理Context**==。持续更新的组织上下文、权限关系、任务证据和评估反馈这些都可以作为持续迭代的context，而无论上游的接入模型是哪个亦或者后续的不同类型的任务，管理好context才能让agent在更符合企业要求的环境下持续工作并且不偏移，因此也更容易进入企业的长期预算。
30c3c0689385625e58e3de8ce565ff45588b37be.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
30c3c0689385625e58e3de8ce565ff45588b37be.translation: ==blue|After adopting the system, however, the establishment of advantages and moats comes from whether one can better **manage Context**==. Continuously updated organizational context, permission relationships, task evidence, and evaluation feedback can all serve as continuously iterated context; regardless of which upstream access model is used or what different types of tasks follow, managing context well is what allows agents to continue working in an environment that better meets enterprise requirements without drifting, and therefore also makes it easier to enter enterprises’ long-term budgets.

63c4f8826084611888b087fce59c66702630fec5.source: 企业可以按一次成功交接来算账。
63c4f8826084611888b087fce59c66702630fec5.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
63c4f8826084611888b087fce59c66702630fec5.translation: Companies can settle accounts based on each successful handover.

cd35120e3eb6de48b371740508ae9e0db9c3bcbd.source:
每次成功交接的净价值
= 节省的人力 + 缩短周期的价值 + 避免的错误损失
- 模型与工具调用 - 集成运维 - 人工复核 - 预期错误损失
cd35120e3eb6de48b371740508ae9e0db9c3bcbd.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
cd35120e3eb6de48b371740508ae9e0db9c3bcbd.translation:
Net value per successful handoff
= Saved labor + Value of reduced cycle time + Avoided error losses
- Model and tool calls - Integration operations - Manual review - Expected error losses

911e002da6c2b8ac506d1b09e5a91a9087cc849f.source: 供应商获得席位收入或用量收入，还要承担推理、检索、存储、连接器、支持和异常处理成本。人工复核如果长期不能从全量降到抽检，客户价值和供应商利润都会受压。错误写入率、正式采购转化和跨部门流程能够连续运行多久，比融资额和发布会上的产品名单更能说明这门生意是否成立。
911e002da6c2b8ac506d1b09e5a91a9087cc849f.context: 企业会为可靠的交接付费
911e002da6c2b8ac506d1b09e5a91a9087cc849f.translation: Vendors earn seat-based or usage-based revenue while also bearing the costs of inference, retrieval, storage, connectors, support, and exception handling. If manual review cannot move from full coverage to spot checks over the long term, both customer value and vendor profitability will come under pressure. The rate of erroneous writes, conversion to formal procurement, and how long cross-departmental processes can keep running say more about whether this business is viable than funding amounts or the product list at a launch event.

cbe1eb9ec7f7f92fc5ed85e23347ecd3c18fcd75.source: 最要紧的风险是错误被真的执行出去。一个只会说错的助手，损失止于一句错话。一个有登录凭据、能写系统的 Agent 说错话，会变成一封发错的邮件、一次错的采购、一次生产环境的变更。所以这三款产品都把高风险动作拦在人这里。Grok Bot 对 shell 和浏览器操作要求逐项批准，Claude Tag 用窄范围的机器身份控制权限半径，飞书用工作流和敏感数据管控把节点固化下来。
cbe1eb9ec7f7f92fc5ed85e23347ecd3c18fcd75.translation: The most critical risk is that mistakes actually get executed. An assistant that only says the wrong thing causes damage limited to one wrong sentence. An Agent with login credentials that can write to systems, when it says the wrong thing, turns into a misdirected email, a wrong purchase, a change in the production environment. That is why all three products stop high-risk actions at the human. Grok Bot requires item-by-item approval for shell and browser operations, Claude Tag uses narrowly scoped machine identities to limit the permission radius, and Feishu uses workflows and sensitive-data controls to lock nodes into place.

43ed103720a973f7a2af96fc49e5559dbb0563b1.source: 同样还有提示词攻击问题，提示注入是结构性的。攻击者可以把指令藏进网页、邮件、issue、PDF 或者插件返回的数据里，让 Agent 把它当成任务。还有三个次一级的缺口。过期记忆会让 Agent 拿着三个月前的结论继续推理。自动化任务还可能自己转圈循环。比如销售 Agent 更新客户状态，触发运营 Agent 发消息；这条消息又被销售 Agent 当成新事件处理，两个 Agent 就会反复唤醒彼此，持续消耗 token，严重时还会重复改数据或发送消息。目前三家公开材料都没有把这些保护措施讲清楚。异构模型治理在豆包这里尤其突出，它允许企业接入自己的模型厂商账户，数据政策要按合同一家一家看，不能只看飞书那一层。
43ed103720a973f7a2af96fc49e5559dbb0563b1.translation: There is also the prompt attack problem: prompt injection is structural. Attackers can hide instructions in web pages, emails, issues, PDFs, or data returned by plugins, making the Agent treat them as tasks. There are also three secondary gaps. Stale memory can lead an Agent to continue reasoning from conclusions reached three months earlier. Automated tasks can also end up looping on their own. For example, a sales Agent updates a customer status, triggering an operations Agent to send a message; that message is then processed by the sales Agent as a new event, causing the two Agents to repeatedly wake each other, continuously consume tokens, and, in severe cases, repeatedly modify data or send messages. None of the three companies’ public materials currently explain these safeguards clearly. Heterogeneous model governance is especially pronounced for Doubao, which allows enterprises to connect their own model vendor accounts; data policies must be examined contract by contract, one by one, rather than only at the Feishu layer.

74b84a1b8d7fc95eac1eea7d9c023510ec345ca9.source: 数据驻留和合规也要单独处理。Grok Bot 的云电脑目前在美国，企业需要确认数据存放地点、跨境传输和供应商合同。中国企业如果把 Agent 生成的内容对外发布，还要按照《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》履行标识义务。
74b84a1b8d7fc95eac1eea7d9c023510ec345ca9.translation: Data residency and compliance also need to be handled separately. Grok Bot’s cloud computers are currently in the United States, so enterprises need to confirm data storage locations, cross-border transfers, and supplier contracts. If Chinese companies publish Agent-generated content externally, they must also fulfill labeling obligations under the Measures for Labeling AI-Generated Synthetic Content.

da4ed0bc9e96dae479dab323c8bf2985897ebd22.source: 组织变化最终会落在正式制度里。企业是否开始调整岗位职责和审批方式，并把 Agent 的权限、交付与验收写进流程，比发布会上的功能数量更值得观察。
da4ed0bc9e96dae479dab323c8bf2985897ebd22.translation: Organizational change ultimately settles into formal rules and systems. Whether companies begin adjusting job responsibilities and approval methods, and write Agent permissions, delivery, and acceptance into their processes, is more worth observing than the number of features at a launch event.

7d07bad4b0a4145db97957d65700690094acf50d.source: ==blue|对个人来说，之后的职责和责任会从执行往定义和验证挪。接下来更重要的考核是能不能判断什么算做好了或者什么值得做。还有重要的是个人在行业领域的垂直经验的积累，只有个人在行业有足够多的沉淀，才会积累出出对于该行业的taste以及一些关键决策的判断力==。
7d07bad4b0a4145db97957d65700690094acf50d.translation: ==blue|For individuals, subsequent duties and responsibilities will shift from execution toward definition and validation. The more important assessment going forward is whether one can judge what counts as done well or what is worth doing. Also important is the accumulation of an individual’s vertical experience in an industry; only when an individual has enough depth in the industry will they develop taste for that industry and judgment for some key decisions==.

a58fcd3019a4bc1dbf114d26a9b93861619d0b66.source: ==blue|对公司来说，顺序和准确比速度重要我认为。先做权限和上下文治理，再把 Agent 铺开，把组织记忆当基础设施建，而不是当提示词写。授权按影响可逆性分层，读和总结可以放开，对外发消息、下单、改生产环境要留在人这里。验收指标也不要选聊天 benchmark，值得测的是长任务完成率、需要人介入的次数、错误的对外写入率、工具调用的重试率和平均每个成功任务的成本。==
a58fcd3019a4bc1dbf114d26a9b93861619d0b66.translation: ==blue|For companies, I think sequencing and accuracy matter more than speed. First handle permissions and context governance, then roll out agents, and build organizational memory as infrastructure rather than writing it as prompts. Authorization should be layered by impact reversibility: reads and summaries can be opened up, while sending external messages, placing orders, and changing production environments should remain with humans. Acceptance metrics also shouldn't be chat benchmarks; what's worth measuring is long-task completion rate, the number of human interventions required, the rate of incorrect external writes, tool-call retry rate, and the average cost per successful task.==
